    Caltech Physics 1b-c

    Undergraduate course, Caltech Physics, 2021

    I was a graduate teaching assistant for the introductory undergraduate class in special relativity and electromagnetism intended for physics majors. The two terms covered topics such as introductory special relativity, electrostatics, magnetostatics, circuits, EM waves, and Lorentz transformations of the EM fields.
